facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Scrooge was an old man. He was not kind to anyone. He hated Christmas. Scrooge was mean.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Ebenezer Scrooge was an old man who lived alone in London. He worked counting money but never shared any of it. He paid his worker Bob very little and had no friends at all. Scrooge was mean and did not care about anyone but himself. He hated Christmas and thought celebrations were a waste. Everyone in town was afraid of the cold, grumpy old man.
